# Local copies of existing layout dependencies

The main workspace previously loaded these files from external URLs. They are now served locally so page initialization does not wait for the external hosts. The downloaded files are unmodified.

- jquery-1.11.1.min.js: https://code.jquery.com/jquery-1.11.1.min.js
- goldenlayout.min.js: https://golden-layout.com/files/latest/js/goldenlayout.min.js
- goldenlayout-base.css: https://golden-layout.com/files/latest/css/goldenlayout-base.css

Retrieved 2026-10-09. These are the existing dependencies, not a library upgrade.
